notes.title: Zombie world version update
notes.content:
Dear Survivor

In order to provide a better gaming experience for everyone, we will update and maintain the server from 15:00 to 15:20 on July 2nd. The specific startup time of the server may be delayed or advanced according to the actual situation. We apologize for any inconvenience caused to survivors! Please tell each other. Thank you all for your understanding and support!

[Updated content]

[New] Light Hero Wings of the Sky

[New] Increase in hero level and star rating limit

[New] Increase the upper limit of gem level

[New] Increase the upper limit of some guild skill levels

【 Optimization 】 In the summoning of time and space, the summoning of darkness and light with a minimum draw of 100 ordinary five stars has been adjusted to a minimum draw of 200 elite five stars

[Optimization] Partial activity reward optimization

[Optimization] Fixed some bugs

notes.title: The end of the day is coming! Fight for survival! Send 5-star heroes online!
notes.content:
New server welfare promotion

1. Charge 6 yuan for the first time and send the guardian camp's super rare SSSR hero humanoid fortress

2. Accumulated recharge of 12 yuan, free of 150 consecutive draws

3. Create an account to give as a gift to the guardian camp's five-star hero demon hunter

4. Rename and send ten consecutive draws

5. Complete the novice guidance task and send ten consecutive draws

6. Upgrade to receive a limited quantity and value gift package, with priority given to quantity and first come, first served.

7. The new server advanced summoning activity is hot, and the probability of high-level summoning 5-star heroes during the event has doubled

8. New server cumulative summoning to enjoy good gifts, advanced summoning up to the corresponding number of times can obtain advanced card exchange and rare items

9 new server and 7 day carnival, meeting the corresponding carnival requirements can obtain a large number of rare props
